scope: Bounded implementation review of authorization, Git execution, review identity, merge recovery, and request limits. Not a complete penetration test.
go: Review submissions require the head OID actually inspected and reject stale approvals.
Request bodies are read before acquiring repository locks and have a ten-second deadline.
Git stdout limiting covers io.Copy fast paths.
Directory freshness uses bounded loose/packed refs without subprocess fallback for empty repositories.
gleam: Git replacement refs cannot alter displayed reviewed content.
Nested native Git subprocesses terminate with their cancelled owner.
Default-branch settings check both Git HEAD and SQLite writes and reconcile startup state.
Atomic internal merge refs preserve evidence across branch resets; failed ledger reads retain recovery intent.
Incremental request parsing bounds HTTP chunks independently of Mist's chunk buffering.
A bounded local FIFO mutex replaces randomized distributed-lock retries, with owner and waiter cancellation checks.
shared: Eight SSH transfer slots are enforced across processes and released after disconnect.
SSH commands are restricted to native Git upload-pack and receive-pack.
Backup archives are created exclusively with mode 0600 before writing.
